meta.name: traction-eos
meta.description: Implement the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) to align vision and execution across a company. Use when the user mentions "EOS", "Entrepreneurial Operating System", "V/TO", "quarterly rocks", "Level 10 meetings", "accountability chart", "IDS process", "my company feels chaotic", "we keep having the same problems", or "get the whole team aligned". Also trigger when a growing company needs meeting structure, goal-setting frameworks, or a systematic way to solve recurring organizational issues. Covers the six EOS components: Vision, People, Data, Issues, Process, Traction. For team motivation design, see drive-motivation. For lean experimentation, see lean-startup.

copy.tagline: 用EOS框架对齐团队愿景与执行
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果公司正面临混乱、重复问题或需要系统化运营框架。
copy.tagline_en: Align team vision and execution with the EOS framework
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your company faces chaos, recurring issues, or needs a systematic operating framework.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你用一套叫 EOS 的系统来管理公司，包括制定愿景、安排人员、看数据、解决问题、规范流程和设定季度目标。它会引导你完成这些步骤，并给出具体工具和模板。
howto.when: 当你提到“EOS”、“V/TO”、“季度岩石”、“Level 10 会议”等关键词，或者抱怨公司混乱、团队不齐心、需要会议结构或目标框架时触发。

say.text: 我们公司最近很乱，能帮我用 EOS 梳理一下吗？
帮我制定下个季度的岩石目标。
我们团队开会效率低，能教我开 Level 10 会议吗？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you run your company using the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS), covering vision, people, data, issues, process, and traction. It guides you through each component with tools and templates.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "EOS", "V/TO", "quarterly rocks", "Level 10 meetings", or similar terms, or when you describe company chaos, misalignment, or need for meeting structure or goal-setting.

say_en.text: Our company feels chaotic. Can you help me use EOS?
say_en.note: Claude will run a quick diagnostic to identify weak areas.

say_en.text: Help me set quarterly rocks for next quarter.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the rock-setting process to define 3-7 priorities.

say_en.text: Our meetings are inefficient. Teach me Level 10 meetings.
say_en.note: Claude will provide the agenda and rules for running a Level 10 meeting.
